website_pages.title: Privacy Policy
website_pages.content:
Flaxy Esports Privacy Policy

Last updated: November 2026

At Flaxy Esports, we take the privacy of our players and tournament participants seriously. This document outlines the information we collect and how it is protected.

1. Information We Collect

  • Account details: Username, Email address, Free Fire UID, and Free Fire In-Game Name (IGN).
  • Payment information: Transaction reference IDs (UTR numbers) and private verification screenshots. We never store credit/debit card numbers.
  • Activity logs: Room join timestamps, match statistics, and IP logs for cheat prevention.

2. How We Protect Your Data

All passwords are encrypted with industry-standard bcrypt hashing. Payment receipts and Free Fire credentials are stored in secure databases and never shared with third parties.

3. Data Retention and Account Deactivation

Users may request complete account deactivation and removal of personal identifiers via the Account Settings panel.

website_pages.title: Terms & Conditions
website_pages.content:
Terms & Conditions

By registering on Flaxy Esports and entering our tournaments, you agree to comply with all rules and terms stated herein.

1. Eligibility

Participants must have an active Free Fire account in good standing. Players using emulators (PC/Mac) are strictly banned from mobile-only tournaments unless specified otherwise.

2. Tournament Entry & Slots

A slot is only confirmed once your manual UPI payment reference is verified and approved by the payment manager. Submitting fraudulent transaction IDs will lead to permanent blacklisting.

3. Room Credentials Protocol

Room ID and Password are confidential and provided exclusively to verified participants. Sharing credentials with unregistered players results in immediate disqualification without refund.

website_pages.title: Refund Policy
website_pages.content:
Refund Policy

Flaxy operates a fair and transparent refund mechanism for all registered participants.

1. Tournament Cancellation

If a tournament is cancelled by Flaxy management due to technical issues, game server maintenance, or insufficient registrations, a 100% full refund is issued back to the user's UPI within 24 hours.

2. Rescheduled Matches

If a match is rescheduled and a participant is unable to play at the new time, they may request a refund through a support ticket up to 1 hour before the new match start time.

3. Disqualification & Forfeiture

No refunds are granted if a player fails to join the room on time, violates tournament rules, or uses unauthorized third-party software.

website_pages.title: Tournament Rules
website_pages.content:
Official Free Fire Tournament Rules

1. Match Format

  • Battle Royale: 48 players per lobby. Maps: Bermuda, Purgatory, Kalahari, Alpine.
  • Clash Squad: 4v4 or 2v2 knockout rounds. First to 7 rounds wins.
  • Lone Wolf: 1v1 or 2v2 tactical showdown.

2. Scoring System

  • 1st Place (Booyah!): 12 Points
  • 2nd Place: 9 Points
  • 3rd Place: 8 Points
  • 4th Place: 7 Points
  • 5th Place: 6 Points
  • 6th - 10th Place: 5 to 1 Points
  • Each Kill: 1 Point

3. Proof of Results

The winning player or team captain must capture a clear end-game screenshot showing ranking, kills, and team members, and upload it via the match results portal.

website_pages.title: Fair Play Policy
website_pages.content:
Fair Play & Anti-Cheat Policy

Flaxy Esports maintains a strict zero-tolerance policy against any form of unfair play, including but not limited to:

  • Aimbot, wallhacks, auto-headshot scripts, or altered APKs.
  • Teaming up with opposing players in Solo tournaments.
  • Use of PC emulators (BlueStacks, LDPlayer, Nox, etc.) in mobile-only brackets.
  • Smurfing or having a professional player play on your account.

Violators face permanent device and account bans, forfeiture of all winnings, and notification to partner esports leagues.

website_pages.title: Payment Information
website_pages.content:
Payment Information & UPI Guidelines

We accept manual UPI payments through all major payment applications in India, including PhonePe, Google Pay, Paytm, BHIM, and Cred.

Verification Steps

  1. Send the exact entry fee to our official UPI ID: flaxy.esports@icici or scan the dynamic QR code shown during checkout.
  2. Locate the 12-digit UPI Reference Number / UTR in your payment receipt.
  3. Upload a screenshot of the completed transaction.
  4. Our payment verification team reviews your transaction reference against our bank statement. Once confirmed (typically 5 to 15 minutes), your tournament slot is locked in.

website_pages.title: How to Join Tournament
website_pages.content:
How to Join a Flaxy Free Fire Tournament

Follow these 4 simple steps to enter the arena and win cash prizes:

  1. Select a Tournament: Browse the Tournaments page and choose your preferred Game Mode (Solo or Duo) and Map.
  2. Register & Pay: Click 'Join Tournament'. For Duo matches, select your teammate. Complete payment via UPI and submit the 12-digit UTR number.
  3. Check Dashboard: Go to 'My Tournaments' to track payment status. Once approved, you are on the confirmed roster.
  4. Get Room Details: Return to the match screen when the live countdown hits zero. Copy the Room ID and Password, open Free Fire, tap Custom Room, enter credentials, and jump into the battle!

faqs.question: How do I pay the tournament entry fee via UPI?
faqs.answer: When you click Join Tournament, the official UPI ID (flaxy.esports@icici) and QR code will appear. Scan it using Google Pay, PhonePe, or Paytm, enter the 12-digit UPI Reference/UTR number, attach a screenshot, and submit. Our staff verifies it within 10 minutes.

faqs.question: When and where will I get the Room ID and Password?
faqs.answer: Room credentials unlock automatically inside your Dashboard under "My Tournaments" exactly at the scheduled Room Opening Time. A live countdown on the match page indicates the exact seconds remaining.

faqs.question: Are PC or laptop emulators allowed?
faqs.answer: No. All Flaxy tournaments are strictly mobile-only (Android / iOS) unless explicitly designated as an Emulator Open event. Any emulator detection will result in an immediate forfeit.

faqs.question: How soon are cash prizes transferred?

faqs.question: How do Duo tournaments work with teammates?
faqs.answer: You can create a team in "My Teams" on your dashboard and invite your partner using their Flaxy username. Once accepted, you can select your duo team during tournament registration.
